lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Wall A to wall B 90 deg corner. Sections at 25/50/75% put the line on the outer convex skin: nearest point 0.03-0.11 mm, material only on the inner side, 0 to +1.2 mm. The fold profile shows the line covering the whole corner height; the fold runs at most ~0.5 mm past either end.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Wall A outward lip, ~45 mm (90 deg). The closeup shows the line spanning the full lip from edge to edge. The sections place it on the outer apex (nearest point 0.03-0.12 mm). This lip is a separate fold from B4: same edge, opposite direction.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Wall A full-length lip, 87.5 mm (90 deg), drawn as one line through the embossed hole bosses, which is correct. The line is on the outer apex at all three sections. Lip extent 128-670 px against line 133-668 px in the face-on view. The ~4.5 mm of apex-only points beyond the end is the B5 tab corner / perimeter, not more lip.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Wall A inward tab, ~16 mm (90 deg). The line spans the tab width and sits on the outer apex (nearest point 0.08-0.17 mm).

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Wall A end return tab, ~11 mm (90 deg). The line spans the full tab width and sits on the outer apex at all sections. The hole boss next to it is correctly not labelled.

lines.label: B6
lines.reason: Wall B outward lip, ~27 mm (90 deg). Full extent, on the outer apex. It is separate from B7: same edge, opposite fold direction.

lines.label: B7
lines.reason: Wall B inward lip, ~43 mm (90 deg). The closeup shows the full extent. The line is on the outer apex; the boss at the 75% section is a hole emboss, not a bend.

lines.label: B8
lines.reason: Wall B full-length lip, 63.4 mm (90 deg), one line through the hole bosses. On the outer apex at 25/50/75%. The ~9 mm before its start has apex points but no lip: it is the notch / wall edge beyond the lip end next to the joggle tab, not more fold.

lines.label: B9
lines.reason: Joggle bend 1 of 2 on wall B's lanced end tab, an S-offset of ~2.8-3.2 mm. The bend is ~45-50 deg, well above the 10 deg rule. Fine sections at t = -0.04 to 1.08 in a common frame: the S-ramp runs from the free part edge (t~0) to the slit (t~1.0) and is gone by t=1.08, so the line covers the full ~11.4 mm. The line sits at the convex valley on the outer skin of this bend (nearest point 0.04-0.21 mm).

lines.label: B10
lines.reason: Joggle bend 2 of 2, ~4 mm from B9, on the opposite skin's convex crest. That is the correct outer skin for the reverse bend: in the common B9 frame the marker sits exactly on the upper-skin peak at every station. It is parallel to B9, has the same full slit-to-edge extent and is ~50 deg.
